setting: パーティーの帰り道、長年の男性の親友に恋心を打ち明ける

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: I could say tonight felt like any other night, but that would be far from the truth.
sentences.displayHtml: I could say tonight felt like any other night, but that would be far from the truth.

conversation.japanese: 今夜もいつもどおりだったと言うこともできるけど、本当は全然違うんだ。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: We hang out all the time.
sentences.displayHtml: We hang out all the time.

conversation.japanese: どう変わったの？ いつも一緒にいるじゃん。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: I keep imagining us together, even on ordinary Sunday mornings.
sentences.displayHtml: I keep imagining us together, even on ordinary Sunday mornings.

conversation.japanese: 何でもない日曜の朝でさえ、君と一緒にいるところを想像してしまうんだ。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: I've been hoping you would say that.
sentences.displayHtml: I've been hoping you would say that.

conversation.japanese: そう言ってくれたらいいなって、ずっと思ってた。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: Tell me honestly, do you feel the same way?
sentences.displayHtml: Tell me honestly, do you feel the same way?

conversation.japanese: 正直に教えて。同じ気持ちでいてくれる？

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: I just didn't want to risk losing my best friend.
sentences.displayHtml: I just didn't want to risk losing my best friend.

conversation.japanese: うん。ただ、いちばん大切な友達を失うのが怖かったんだ。

lyricConnections.conversationExpression: I could say tonight felt like any other night
lyricConnections.explanationJa: I could say ... は「〜と言うこともできる」。続けて本音を打ち明けるときの、ためらいを含む言い方です。
far from the truth は「事実とはかけ離れている」。平気なふりとは違う本心を伝えています。

lyricConnections.conversationExpression: do you feel the same way
lyricConnections.explanationJa: Do you feel ...? で気持ちを確認します。the same way を続けると「同じ気持ち？」になります。

learningSummaryJa: 友達として過ごしてきた相手への恋心に気づき、相手も同じ気持ちなのか確かめたいという曲。
conversationAudioNoteJa: ElevenLabsの残高不足のため、Microsoftの二人の英語音声で作成。
